To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance gain in the outage probability obtained by cognitive femtocells in a two-tier HetNet is significant and can be as high as 50% for a moderate number of femtocells and users in a multichanneled environment.

the performance of the HetNet is significantly affected by the number of channels available for the cognitive FAPS, the spectrum sensing threshold, and the number of macro BSs, and that the optimal spectrum sensing threshold is a decreasing function of the number of macro-BSs.

the outage probability of the femto-tier in a two-tier HetNet is a decreasing function of the sensing threshold of the cognitive FAP, which depends on a number of HetNet parameters, and that the overall performance of such a HetNet is quite misleading and needs to be carefully studied and optimized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of HetNets with cognitive femtocells, where the femtocells are capable of detecting the presence of macro base stations and adapt their transmission parameters to avoid interference.
a realistic scenario where a large number of users are served in the macro-tier, and a small fraction of them is served in the femto-tier.
a realistic and practical two-tier HetNet scenario and provides valuable insights into the downlink performance of the femto-tier in a multichannels environment
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the performance gain obtained by cognition in femtocell networks is not trivial, it can be significant, and it can be optimized.
the performance of the femto-tier is significantly improved by introducing cognition, while the macro-tier performance is only slightly affected.

the performance of a HetNet with cognitive FAPs is a function of the HetNet parameters and the spectrum sensing threshold of the cognitive FAP, and that there exists an optimal sensing threshold for a given set of HetNet parameters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, in a HetNet, the cognitive FAP can be used to enhance the performance of femtocell users, and the overall system performance can be improved by carefully designing the spectrum sensing threshold for cognitive FAPs.

, in the presence of macro BSs, cognitive FAPs can significantly improve the performance of the femto-tier users, and the overall system performance can be improved by carefully designing the spectrum sensing thresholds of the cognitive FAP users.
the performance of HetNests can be enhanced by introducing cognitive FAPs into the femto tier.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in a multichannels environment, the spectrum sensing threshold of the FAPs should be carefully chosen in order to maximize the performance gain obtained by the cognitive FAP operation.
, by properly designing the spectrum sensing threshold of the FAPs, the femto-tier can be made robust to inter-tier interference, thus achieving significant performance gain in outage.
cognition in femtocells is a key enabler for enhancing their performance and that of the overall HetNets.
